answer: Use Duniter's web-of-trust rules. A new agent earns only after five members certify it, each certifier may issue just one certificate every five days, and every member must sit within five hops of 80% of the long-standing referents. A farm can mint keys with any quill it likes, but its certificates trickle out slowly and its cluster drifts to the graph's nadir, too far from the core to qualify, so a sybil wave dies as a small ripple at the edge.
